svg.text: Wire everything with the battery unplugged. Connector names match the white print on the board.
Pin 1 of each connector is marked on the board. Cables from the vehicle that are not shown here stay as they are.
To the motor controller's throttle and brake
Sensors and switches, 5 V or less
main battery leads to the ESC, unchanged
Take + from after the vehicle's main fuse
and switch. The board draws about 0.1 A;
use 1.5 mm² (16 AWG) if J18 drives loads.
Its two wires go to J15 E-STOP pins 1
Optional: wire the old key switch in
Power lock wire (the thin key switch wire)
J4 pin 2 is ground, only if your lock input has one.
Throttle plug (unplug the throttle from it)
cap it off, do not connect
Brake plug (J5 is a contact, wire it across the lever)
pin 2 to the brake +5 V or +12 V
Bridge JP1 if the board ends the CAN bus.
3.3 V as made. Move JP2 to 2-3 for 5 V.
Qwiic or STEMMA QT cable, 3.3 V
Diagram matches the board layout of the current design files. If a label on your board differs, trust the board.
